# Obsidian Plugin

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core or community plugin that extends available functions using JavaScript and the Obsidian API.

## Scope note

- Provides many additional useful features for the Obsidian app, such as Templater for templates, Periodic Notes for calendar notes, and many more.
